verdict.rationale: Aider is fundamentally a terminal-run coding agent: pip-installable CLI, run against local git repos, with rich in-terminal command set (/add, /run, /test, /architect, etc.) and even local model support via Ollama, all confirmed by first-party docs and corroborated by hands-on community usage reports. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of terminal UX polish or edge-case reliability beyond anecdotal HN comments.
